motifs.name: Net material advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has a higher total material value than the opponent.
motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'Net material advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a higher total material value than the opponent.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    values = {chess.PAWN: 1, chess.KNIGHT: 3, chess.BISHOP: 3, chess.ROOK: 5, chess.QUEEN: 9}
    own = sum(values[p] * len(board.pieces(p, stm)) for p in values)
    opp = sum(values[p] * len(board.pieces(p, not stm)) for p in values)
    return own > opp

motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'Secure advanced passed-pawn superiority'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'At near material parity, the side to move has a secure advanced passed pawn substantially stronger than any opposing passer.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    values = {chess.PAWN: 1, chess.KNIGHT: 3, chess.BISHOP: 3,
              chess.ROOK: 5, chess.QUEEN: 9}

    def material(color):
        return sum(values[p] * len(board.pieces(p, color)) for p in values)

    if board.is_check() or abs(material(stm) - material(not stm)) > 1:
        return False

    def passer_score(color):
        enemy = not color
        pawns = board.pieces(chess.PAWN, color)
        enemy_pawns = board.pieces(chess.PAWN, enemy)
        best = 0
        for sq in pawns:
            f, r = chess.square_file(sq), chess.square_rank(sq)
            progress = r if color == chess.WHITE else 7 - r
            if progress < 4:
                continue
            passed = True
            for ep in enemy_pawns:
                ef, er = chess.square_file(ep), chess.square_rank(ep)
                if abs(ef - f) <= 1 and ((color and er > r) or (not color and er < r)):
                    passed = False
                    break
            if not passed:
                continue

            defenders = board.attackers(color, sq)
            attackers = board.attackers(enemy, sq)
            pawn_guard = any(
                board.piece_at(x).piece_type == chess.PAWN for x in defenders
            )
            connected = any(
                x != sq and abs(chess.square_file(x) - f) == 1
                and abs(chess.square_rank(x) - r) <= 1 for x in pawns
            )

            score = 2 * progress + 2 * int(pawn_guard)
            score += int(bool(defenders)) + int(connected)
            score += 2 if len(attackers) <= len(defenders) else -3

            nr = r + (1 if color else -1)
            front = chess.square(f, nr)
            if board.piece_at(front) is None:
                score += 1
                fa = len(board.attackers(enemy, front))
                fd = len(board.attackers(color, front))
                score += int(fa == 0 or fd >= fa)
            else:
                score -= 2
            best = max(best, score)
        return best

    own = passer_score(stm)
    opposing = passer_score(not stm)
    return bool(own >= 11 and own >= opposing + 3)

import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'Castled king versus central king'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'At equal material, the side to move has a pawn-sheltered castled king while the opponent king remains in the center.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    values = (0, 1, 3, 3, 5, 9)

    own_material = sum(values[t] * len(board.pieces(t, stm)) for t in range(1, 6))
    opp_material = sum(values[t] * len(board.pieces(t, opp)) for t in range(1, 6))
    if own_material != opp_material or board.is_check():
        return False

    king = board.king(stm)
    enemy_king = board.king(opp)
    if king is None or enemy_king is None or not board.pieces(chess.QUEEN, stm):
        return False

    home = 0 if stm else 7
    enemy_home = 7 if stm else 0
    if chess.square_rank(king) != home or chess.square_file(king) not in (2, 6):
        return False
    if chess.square_file(enemy_king) not in (3, 4):
        return False
    if abs(chess.square_rank(enemy_king) - enemy_home) > 1:
        return False

    direction = 1 if stm else -1
    shield = 0
    for file in range(max(0, chess.square_file(king) - 1),
                      min(7, chess.square_file(king) + 1) + 1):
        for distance in (1, 2):
            rank = home + direction * distance
            piece = board.piece_at(chess.square(file, rank))
            if piece and piece.color == stm and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN:
                shield += 1
    return shield >= 2
